fact: INSTAD's Annuaire statistique 2024 (figures 2019-2023) publishes tables sourced to the Direction Generale de la Population et de la Famille (births and deaths registered in Djibouti-ville), the Tribunal de Statut Personnel (marriages and divorces), the Gabode civil prison, the CNSS (declared employees), the health ministry's DSIS and the education ministry's MENFOP yearbook; the 2024 date is the padded publication date, at year precision, not the figures' year.
